summary: Retain Node runtime inspection semantics for arbitrary JS values, custom inspectors, circular references, getters, and formatting options.

target.notes: The output is diagnostic and Node-version-sensitive; runtime compatibility is safer than pretending C# ToString is equivalent.

semantics.options: depth, colors, getters, hidden properties and other options affect output
semantics.side_effects: getter/custom-inspector invocation can be observable depending on options

caveats: Do not lower to object.ToString() or JSON serialization.
Exact textual output can vary across Node versions; target compatibility version must be defined by the runtime.

tests.name: normal object inspection
tests.expected_behavior: returns a Node-style diagnostic string containing a: 1

tests.name: edge circular object
tests.expected_behavior: returns a finite string marking the circular reference rather than throwing for recursion
